reconstruction_notes: Evidence-informed stylized living reconstruction, not a fossil scan or complete skeletal restoration.
Cranial outline and paired posterior dorsal orbits are informed by Fig.4G SMNS4698 alone; living thickness is artistic.
Lower-jaw symphyseal tusks and distinct anterior upper-roof exits precede separate nares.
Nominal2.9m whole body is an art-design choice;0.62m skull reference is not a measured complete body.
Elongate trunk, small splayed limbs, compact unresolved-digit feet and laterally compressed tail are conservative postcranial restorations.
Color, soft tissue, precise proportions, pose and life appearance are unknown/artistic.
Museum photograph was consulted only; no source image/text/mesh/texture is incorporated.
